description: JavaScript code for TinyMCE plugin handling table cell editing, including style parsing, updating cell attributes, and UI interactions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the table cell editing dialog, populates form fields with current cell styles and attributes.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Handles user actions to update table cells, rows, or entire tables based on form input.

methods.name: nextCell
methods.description: Finds the next table cell (td or th) sibling.

methods.name: updateCell
methods.description: Updates the attributes and styles of a table cell element based on form input.

methods.name: changedBackgroundImage
methods.description: Updates the background-image style based on form input.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Updates width and height styles based on form input.

methods.name: changedColor
methods.description: Updates background and border color styles based on form input.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Parses style string and updates form fields accordingly.
